info.title: NumisLens Daemon
info.description: Local API for the NumisLens coin collection.

Response Create Coin Api V1 Coins Post

get.description:
List coins. The body stays a bare array (backward compatible); the
total matching count rides in ``X-Total-Count`` for paging clients.

schema.title: Response List Coins Api V1 Coins Get

post.description:
Deterministically parse free text and create a coin if it is safe to.

NO LLM, NO guessing. The coin is created only when at least a series or a
year parsed cleanly; otherwise this responds 422 with what it did and did
not understand. Composition is set only by numismatically CERTAIN rules;
grade is never parsed. Unmapped phrases (unknown locations, uncertain
compositions, malformed money) are returned in ``unresolved`` — a mentioned
location that does not already exist is listed there, NOT auto-created.
Any leftover input text no extractor consumed (unknown words, extra year
tokens beyond the first) is echoed back in ``unresolved`` as
``unrecognized: "..."`` entries, so nothing is silently dropped.

get.description:
Candidate duplicate identities (same series+year+mintmark).

Read-only suspect list for inherited-collection triage: double entries
surface with their locations; adjudication is human work.

Response Get Coin Api V1 Coins  Accession  Get

patch.description:
Fill NULL identification fields on an existing coin (Phase-4 writeback).

Fill-NULL-ONLY: any field the coin already has is left untouched and
reported in ``skipped`` — a vision pass never overwrites a user/human
identity or grade. This is the sole endpoint that sets ``grade_bucket``
outside coin creation, and only with a ``grade_source`` recording that a
photo pipeline produced it. Returns ``{written, skipped, coin}``.

schema.title: Response Identify Coin Api V1 Coins  Accession  Patch

put.description:
Apply a human correction to a coin (distinct from the vision PATCH).

Every provided field overwrites (including clearing via null); each change
is logged to the append-only events table with its before/after. Grade
fields are not editable here — grade changes go through /appraise or the
vision writeback so provenance stays append-only. Returns
``{changed: {field: [before, after]}, coin}``.

schema.title: Response Edit Coin Api V1 Coins  Accession  Put
Response Move Coin Api V1 Coins  Accession  Move Post

post.description:
Move a coin through owned -> for_sale -> sold (or discarded).

Marking sold requires ``sold_price_cents`` (0 = a giveaway — a real
outcome, not an unknown). Every transition appends a 'disposition' event;
non-sold states clear the sold_* fields. Returns the fresh coin row.

Avery 5160 sheet of roll labels. ``?rolls=NR-...&rolls=...`` (repeatable)
selects specific rolls; omitted selects every non-exhausted roll.

schema.title: Response Appraisal Json Api V1 Report Appraisal Get

get.description:
The 'what deserves eyes first' appraisal worklist.

Owned coins whose identity matches a notable entry in the curated
reference data (a key date, say) but whose current best value falls
short of it — sorted by the gap. potential_cents is an attention
signal from cited data, never a written value; grade determines where
a given coin actually lands.

schema.title: Response Worklist Api V1 Worklist Get

get.description:
Realized P&L over sold coins (proceeds minus cost basis).

Missing inputs are disclosed (``missing_cost_count``), never imputed —
the no-fabrication rule applies to profit as much as to value.

schema.title: Response Portfolio Realized Api V1 Portfolio Realized Get

get.description:
Value-watch snapshot: stale coins, the top-value watchlist, spot deltas.

``n`` bounds the watchlist (top coins by ``value_est_cents``). The ``stale``
list is capped at 100 entries; ``stale_count`` is the true total.

schema.title: Response Watch Status Api V1 Watch Status Get

post.description:
Deterministic sink for a weekly market digest — mark coins stale in bulk.

Each item names EXACTLY ONE target (series, set_id, or accessions) plus a
reason; the daemon marks the matching coins stale and reports the per-item
matched-coin count. This never changes any value — it only flags coins for a
later lazy re-appraisal.

Fail-loud contract: an unknown series returns HTTP 422 with the list of
series that DO exist (nothing is marked). An item that does not name exactly
one target is also a 422. Do not mark stale on a hunch — cite a source_note.

get.description:
Every coin as CSV — stable columns, integer cents, composition by name,
location by path. ``accession_no`` is informational on import (ignored).

post.description:
Bulk-add coins from a CSV exported by (or shaped like) this endpoint.

Strict all-or-nothing: every row is validated before anything is created;
any problem returns 422 with every row error listed and an unchanged
ledger. ``accession_no`` is ignored (server-assigned); unknown locations/
compositions are errors, never auto-created.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Citation for the appraisal (auction result, dealer listing, price-guide page) — provenance belongs in the record.

cost_basis_cents.title: Cost Basis Cents
cost_basis_cents.description: Cost basis in cents (integer); null clears.

value_est_cents.title: Value Est Cents
value_est_cents.description: Estimated value in cents (integer); null clears.

items.title: Items
items.description: Distilled findings; each marks its target coins stale.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why these coins may have moved (required).

source_note.title: Source Note
source_note.description: Citation for the finding (headline, auction record, URL).

sold_price_cents.title: Sold Price Cents
sold_price_cents.description: Realized price in cents (integer); required when disposition='sold'.

expected_from_location_id.title: Expected From Location Id
expected_from_location_id.description: Optimistic concurrency: fail with 409 if the coin is no longer at this location.

text.title: Text
text.description: Free-text coin capture, e.g. '1943 steel cent, box 3 slot 12, paid $4'.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of coins in the roll (>= 1).

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of coins to pull out of the roll (>= 1).

quick.title: Quick
quick.description: Optional free-text captures (len <= count); each is run through the quick-add parser to create a real coin row, acquired_source=roll_no.

bearerAuth.description: Daemon bearer token. Send as: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
